Our family
newsletter
December 20XX
Add caption here
Happy holidays from our
family to yours!
Holiday newsletters are a great way to keep the people closest to
you updated on your family's life. It's also a fun way to share
holiday greetings or write about your past year's experiences. To
start, let each of your family write down their own articles in the
newsletter. Add photographs from family vacations. Think about
what you would tell your family and friends if you could see them.
A family newsletter is also a fun activity to do as a family. Everyone
feels included when you share memories with each other. Sit down
and talk about the important things that happened in the past year.
Also, think about who's reading your newsletter. What would your
friends or distant relatives most want to hear about? Write down
your ideas and then organize your list into categories.

Adding pictures to your
newsletter
Pictures of your family trips or special events can
bring your newsletter to life. Once you've chosen a
picture, place it close to the information. Be sure to
put the caption of the image near the image. Want
to use online images in your newsletter? Find
thousands of images online to download and insert
into your newsletter. To change the pictures in
this newsletter to your own, select the image you
wish to change. Go to Insert, Pictures, and then
select either Pictures or Online Pictures. Locate
the image you want and double-click it. The new
picture will add to the existing text box for easy
positioning. Tip: Borders may not show on text
boxes that contain images or text. Before you add
anything else, make sure it's placed within a text
box. Pictures of your family trips or special events

Write with ease using Editor
We’ve added a new feature in Word that can help you elevate
your writing. You've probably used tools like spell checker to
look for spelling mistakes, and Editor can help you with that too.
In fact, anyone can use Editor for grammar and spelling help
across Word, Outlook.com, and the web. Editor is free with a
Microsoft sign-in, but Microsoft 365 subscribers have access to
advanced grammar and style refinements. When you’re a
subscriber, you'll unlock the ability to scan your writing for
conciseness, formal language, vocabulary suggestions, and more
.

Use Editor to flag for wordiness, conjunction overuse, passive

can sharpen your writing and make it easier to understand.
